# curl2_azuread_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Fetches an Azure AD access token without storing it in the plan or state. Uses the provider's `azure_ad` block. Requires Terraform 1.10 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires Terraform 1.10 or later. The token is never written to the plan or state.
terraform {
  required_providers {
    curl2 = {
      source  = "mehulgohil/curl2"
      version = "1.8.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "curl2" {
  azure_ad {
    client_id     = "<AZURE_CLIENT_ID>"     //You can also set ENV AZURE_CLIENT_ID
    client_secret = "<AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET>" //You can also set ENV AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
    tenant_id     = "<AZURE_TENANT_ID>"     //You can also set ENV AZURE_TENANT_ID
  }
}

ephemeral "curl2_azuread_token" "graph" {
  scopes = ["https://graph.microsoft.com/.default"]
}

ephemeral "curl2" "me" {
  http_method  = "GET"
  uri          = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me"
  auth_type    = "Bearer"
  bearer_token = ephemeral.curl2_azuread_token.graph.token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scopes` (List of String) Resource identifiers (application ID URIs) with the .default suffix. Example: ["https://graph.microsoft.com/.default"]

### Read-Only

- `expires_on` (String) When the token expires, in RFC 3339 format.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The access token.
